Awards & Achievements

Pursuing Excellence
Kai Shing constantly strives for innovation. To meet the growing service demands,
we have been integrating innovative technologies into property management services and improving service quality provided by our staff, aiming to create exceptional service experience for our customers.

Awards
Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence
Presented by
Environment and Conservation Fund
  • Kai Shing has been receiving accolades at the "Hong Kong Awards for Environmental Excellence" for over a decade. The company’s adoption of environmental management practices and commitment to promoting sustainable development have been well recognised in the industry.
Awards
Quality Property Facility and Management Award
Presented by
The Hong Kong Association of Property Management Companies Limited and The Hong Kong Institute of Surveyors Property and Facility Management Division
  • Kai Shing and Supreme have consistently excelled at the "Quality Property Facility Management Award" every year. The properties managed under Kai Shing’s portfolio have stood out in the judging process, showcasing the team’s outstanding performance in property management and earning recognition from various sectors.
Awards
Service Talent Award
Presented by
The Hong Kong Retail Management Association
  • The "Service Talent Award" is widely regarded as “Oscar” in the service industry. Over the years, Kai Shing has not only received multiple company awards, but its managed properties and teams have also won numerous service awards at the annual award ceremony every year, gaining recognition of its professional service quality from various sectors.
Awards
HKIH Elite Awards
Presented by
The Hong Kong Institute of Housing
  • Kai Shing has been actively participating in the "HKIH Elite Awards" and has received numerous awards in different categories, including the "Outstanding Team (Private Housing - Non-Residential)" and the Excellence Award of "Best Innovative Ideas". These achievements highlight the professional and excellent services provided by Kai Shing’s frontline team.
Awards
The HKIFM Excellence in FM Award
Presented by
The Hong Kong Institute of Facility Management
  • Kai Shing consistently receives multiple awards at "The HKIFM Excellence in FM Award" every year, demonstrating the professionalism of Kai Shing’s facility management team in providing facility management services.
Awards
Residential Clubhouse Management Awards
Presented by
Hong Kong Recreation Management Association
  • As a pioneer in residential clubhouse management, Kai Shing participates annually in the "Residential Clubhouse Management Awards" and consistently achieves outstanding results. Apart from confirming the continuous excellence in clubhouse services provided under its management, Kai Shing also sets an example for the industry.
Awards
Excellence in Architecture Awards
Presented by
Hong Kong Institution of Engineers - Building Services Division
  • Kai Shing has been recognised for its efforts in enhancing property operational efficiency and has received the "Excellence in Architecture Awards (Existing Building Category)" and the "Excellence in Carbon Neutral Achievement Awards (Existing Building Category)" at the "Excellence in Architecture Awards."
Awards
Innovative Energy Saving Enterprise Award
Presented by
CLP Power
  • Kai Shing actively implements green management and carbon emission reduction measures in its managed properties. It has been awarded the "Energy Management Award" at the "Innovative Energy Saving Enterprise Awards" organised by CLP Power. The company has also won the Gold Award in the "Power Saving Mission - Active Power Saving Award", further recognising its achievements and efforts in environmental management and energy conservation.
Awards
Asia-Pacific Excellence Awards
Presented by
International Facility Management Association
  • Kai Shing’s property management services have gained recognition not only in Hong Kong and Mainland China but also throughout the Asia-Pacific region. The company consistently achieves multiple accolades at each edition of the "Asia-Pacific Excellence Awards", leading the industry in setting higher standards.
